input.source: Authenticated pre-execution mapped-design topology using build_runtime_graphs_v1 node and directed edge-pair schema
input.node: One standard-cell instance with cell_type and explicit boolean sequential_flag
input.edge: Unique directed driver-cell to consumer-cell pair, not number of connected pins or nets
input.bound_status: Implementation input bounds, not observed peak memory or proof that every real graph fits

features.name: log1p_edge_count
features.definition: log(1 + number of unique directed cell edges)

features.name: sequential_cell_fraction
features.definition: Sequential nodes / all nodes; requires qualified sequential flags

features.name: mean_fanout
features.definition: Mean unique outgoing-cell degree over all nodes including sinks

features.name: p95_fanout
features.definition: Sorted outgoing degrees at integer nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N), including zeros

features.name: logic_depth
features.definition: Maximum combinational-cell count on a directed path after cutting edges into sequential nodes; isolated combinational node=1, sequential-only=0

cycle_policy: Remaining combinational cycle gives missing depth and incomplete feature vector. Do not impute zero or silently drop a family; resolve graph/descriptor scope before the ablation
topology_limitations: Descriptors concern the supplied cell graph, not electrical pin/net fanout or STA depth. The existing builder uses regex pin/sequential classification and omits self edges; qualification must address those source limitations before real use
digest_scope: descriptor_topology_sha256 uses this descriptor's canonical payload without trailing LF. It is not the builder topology hash, raw graph file hash or an isomorphism-invariant graph identity
normalization: Fit using fitting families only; frozen transform for held family; no clipping or held-data extrema

ablation.A: Seven REQUESTED_COUNT_V1 features plus six deliberately masked zero structural slots
ablation.B: Same seven request features plus six STATIC_CIRCUIT_SUMMARY_V1 descriptors
ablation.hidden_network: Both arms use identical 13->32->32->1 architecture, 1537 parameters and paired identical initial weights; fixed objective, updates and seeds
ablation.mask_scope: A's six zero slots are a prespecified ablation intervention, never an imputation for missing graph data. Qualify every graph and complete descriptor vector before either arm
ablation.avoid_confounds: No simultaneous estimator retuning, graph encoder replacement, F-completion policy mixing or expanded training budget
ablation.causal_limit: Matched architecture isolates the availability of structural inputs, but does not prove the cause of historical transfer failure or generalization beyond the tested families
